message.content:
You are running one benchmark command for a GPU kernel-fusion study on a **MetaX C500**, then
sanity-checking its output. Do not modify any source file. Do not tune anything. Do not
"improve" the script. The point is an INDEPENDENT REPLICATE of a measurement that already
exists, so the two runs can be compared — changing anything would defeat that.

Environment:
- Python: /home/zhangshuhan/my-envs/fusion/bin/python
- Working dir: /home/zhangshuhan/fusion  (run from here)
- **Your GPU is exclusive. Prefix the command with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<N>** (your N below).
  Another agent is benchmarking on the other GPU; never touch it. GPU 2 is hardware-dead.
- The run takes roughly 15-25 minutes. Launch it with nohup writing to a log file, then poll
  the log rather than blocking a foreground call for that long, e.g.:

    cd /home/zhangshuhan/fusion && CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<N> nohup \
      /home/zhangshuhan/my-envs/fusion/bin/python -u glm52/bench/bench_layer_ab.py \
      --regimes <REGIME> --rounds 8 --rep 15 --top 5 --force K_f3_f8,D_f6 \
      --out <OUTNAME> > /tmp/ab_<REGIME>.log 2>&1 & disown

  Then check /tmp/ab_<REGIME>.log periodically until it prints "wrote results/<OUTNAME>.json".
  Do NOT chain short sleeps in a loop to poll; use a single long sleep between checks.

What the script does: it times ~7 whole-layer fusion CONFIGURATIONS end to end, over 8
interleaved rounds (within each round every configuration is timed once, in a fixed order, so
drift affecting a whole round cancels in the per-configuration median). It reports a winner
only when its gap to the runner-up exceeds the round-to-round spread of both; otherwise it
reports them as tied.

When it finishes, verify and report:
1. The output JSON exists and parses: results/<OUTNAME>.json
2. Every configuration passed correctness (the script drops any that fail against its fp32
   reference and prints "FAILS CORRECTNESS" — report whether any did).
3. Per configuration: the median ms, the round-to-round spread percentage, and whether it is
   in the reported tied set.
4. The verdict line: best configuration, gap to runner-up, round noise, separated-or-tied,
   and the speedup vs the all-unfused baseline.
5. Anything anomalous: a spread above ~1%, a configuration whose median is wildly different
   from the others, or MACA driver errors in the log (lines containing MCR/MXKW/Xnack).

Report the numbers. Do not interpret whether fusion is "worth it" — that judgement is made
elsewhere with both runs in hand.

# YOUR ASSIGNMENT
GPU: **CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=3**
REGIME: **decode_bs1024**
OUTNAME: **layer_configurations_ab_new2_bs1024**

content.content: fatal: not a git repository (or any of the parent directories): .git

1	"""Interleaved A/B re-measurement of the top layer configurations.
2	
3	The first pass (`bench_layer.py`) separates the clear losers, but its winners land within
4	~0.4 % of each other — at or below this machine's noise floor (the study logged one-off
5	excursions of 25-320 %). Declaring a winner from a single sequential pass would be
6	over-reading the data.
7	
8	This runs R rounds, and within each round times every candidate once, in the same order.
9	Drift that affects a whole round cancels in the per-config median. A winner is reported only
10	when its median is separated from the runner-up's by more than the round-to-round spread of
11	both; otherwise the configurations are reported as tied.
12	"""
13	
14	from __future__ import annotations
15	
16	import argparse
17	import json
18	import statistics
19	import sys
20	from pathlib import Path
21	
22	import torch
23	
24	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent
25	sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
26	
27	from glm52.bench.bench_layer import (  # noqa: E402
28	    CONFIGS, FAMILY_TUNED, LayerProblem, REGIMES, build_chain, load_cfgs,
29	    tune_layer_cfgs, tune_shared,
30	)
31	from glm52.common import bench_chain, check, record  # noqa: E402
32	
33	RESULTS = ROOT / "results"
34	
35	
36	def main() -> None:
37	    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
38	    ap.add_argument("--regimes", default=",".join(REGIMES))
39	    ap.add_argument("--rounds", type=int, default=8)
40	    ap.add_argument("--rep", type=int, default=15)
41	    ap.add_argument("--top", type=int, default=6)
42	    ap.add_argument("--force", default="", help="comma-separated configs to always include")
43	    ap.add_argument("--out", default="layer_configurations_ab")
44	    args = ap.parse_args()
45	    forced = [s.strip() for s in args.force.split(",") if s.strip()]
46	
47	    first = json.loads((RESULTS / "layer_configurations.json").read_text())["regimes"]
48	    out = {}
49	
50	    for regime in args.regimes.split(","):
51	        regime = regime.strip()
52	        print(f"\n===== {regime} (interleaved, {args.rounds} rounds) =====", flush=True)
53	        prev = {k: v["ms"] for k, v in first[regime]["rows"].items()
54	                if "ms" in v and v.get("correct")}
55	        cands = sorted(prev, key=prev.get)[: args.top]
56	        for extra in forced + ["A_all_unfused"]:
57	            if extra not in cands and extra in CONFIGS:
58	                cands.append(extra)
59	        print(f"  candidates: {', '.join(cands)}", flush=True)
60	
61	        p = LayerProblem(regime)
62	        cfg = load_cfgs(regime) if regime in FAMILY_TUNED else tune_layer_cfgs(p)
63	        shared = tune_shared(p)
64	        chains = {}
65	        for name in cands:
66	            chains[name] = build_chain(p, cfg, CONFIGS[name], shared)
67	            p.out.zero_()
68	            for fn in chains[name]:
69	                fn()
70	            torch.cuda.synchronize()
71	            ck = check(p.out.clone(), p.ref_out, tol=5e-2, label=name)
72	            if not ck["ok"]:
73	                print(f"  {name} FAILS CORRECTNESS ({ck['rel_err']:.2e}) — dropped", flush=True)
74	                chains.pop(name)
75	
76	        rounds: dict[str, list[float]] = {k: [] for k in chains}
77	        for r in range(args.rounds):
78	            for name, chain in chains.items():
79	                t = bench_chain(chain, warmup=5, rep=args.rep)
80	                rounds[name].append(t.p50_ms)
81	            print(f"  round {r}: " + "  ".join(
82	                f"{n}={rounds[n][-1]:.4f}" for n in chains), flush=True)
83	
84	        stats = {}
85	        for name, xs in rounds.items():
86	            xs_s = sorted(xs)
87	            stats[name] = {
88	                "median": statistics.median(xs),
89	                "min": xs_s[0], "max": xs_s[-1],
90	                "spread_pct": (xs_s[-1] - xs_s[0]) / statistics.median(xs) * 100,
91	                "rounds": xs,
92	            }
93	
94	        order = sorted(stats, key=lambda k: stats[k]["median"])
95	        best, runner = order[0], order[1] if len(order) > 1 else None
96	        verdict = {}
97	        if runner:
98	            gap = stats[runner]["median"] - stats[best]["median"]
99	            # separated only if the gap exceeds the larger of the two round-to-round spreads
100	            noise = max(stats[best]["max"] - stats[best]["min"],
101	                        stats[runner]["max"] - stats[runner]["min"])
102	            separated = gap > noise
103	            tied = [n for n in order
104	                    if stats[n]["median"] - stats[best]["median"] <= noise]
105	            verdict = {"best": best, "runner_up": runner, "gap_ms": gap,
106	                       "noise_ms": noise, "separated": separated, "tied_set": tied}
107	            print(f"  --> {best} median {stats[best]['median']:.4f} ms; "
108	                  f"gap to {runner} = {gap:.4f} ms, round noise = {noise:.4f} ms -> "
109	                  f"{'SEPARATED' if separated else 'TIED with ' + ', '.join(tied)}", flush=True)
110	        base = stats.get("A_all_unfused", {}).get("median")
111	        if base:
112	            print(f"      vs all-unfused: {base / stats[best]['median']:.4f}x", flush=True)
113	        out[regime] = {"stats": stats, "verdict": verdict,
114	                       "speedup_vs_unfused": (base / stats[best]["median"]) if base else None}
115	        del p
116	        torch.cuda.empty_cache()
117	
118	    record(args.out, {
119	        "id": args.out,
120	        "protocol": f"{args.rounds} interleaved rounds, rep={args.rep} per round; "
121	                    "per-config median across rounds; a winner is declared only if its gap "
122	                    "to the runner-up exceeds the round-to-round spread of both",
123	        "regimes": out,
124	    })
125	    print(f"\nwrote results/{args.out}.json")
126	
127	
128	if __name__ == "__main__":
129	    main()
130
